_note: DESIGN-TBD: prices and most tier counts are placeholders (OPEN_QUESTIONS §4), except the owner's dash upgrades (USER_REQUESTS.md): four total tiers, the existing base price and three upgrades at 800 / 1000 / 1200 credits. GDD §8 fixes the weapon's four tiers. R7 laid these prices against tools/measure/economy.gd's reading of the post-playtest economy (G1 pace, G3 free armor, G4 laser tier 1); I7 rebalanced them for all eight zones (GDD §7, the owner's answer of October 14, 2026): each tier is read at its line total (its price and every tier before it, since tiers are bought in order) against the wallet of a typical player who finishes every level once, and test_economy.gd pins the level each tier first fits at (the table is in docs/architecture/economy-platforms.md). Held: Armor I 350 (the October 3 early-economy revision), Laser I 1800 (first affordable at the campaign's 4th level, Gangland 1) and the dash's four prices. Moved: Armor IV 5500, Missile 3800, Heavy missile 6000 and Slow time 6000; see docs/questions/i7.md.
